08Data, method and limits

Glossary

  • Concentration index (CI) — 2·covw(supply per resident, population-weighted rank)/mean. +1 = all supply at the top of the ranking, 0 = proportional, −1 = all at the bottom.
  • Erreygers CI — the same for a yes/no or 0–100 % outcome: 8·covw(y, rank)/(max−min).
  • 95 % band — percentile bootstrap over units, 1,000 resamples; "significant" = band excludes zero.
  • Gini — inequality of chargers per resident across units, weighted by residents; blind to who is rich or poor.
  • Theil T — entropy inequality measure that splits exactly into between- and within-group parts.
  • 20:20 — chargers held by the best-served 20 % of residents over the worst-served 20 %.
